job: Name the person at the desk and the business, then offer two doors — load the Master Price File (53 tables · 15,691 rows, 28 of them fitment joins, read from data/northside/manifest.json) or start a blank sheet. Say plainly that this is not authentication until Milestone 6: no password field, nothing checked, the name kept in this browser. A returning visitor never sees this screen again; the next visit lands on Home.

directions.name: Water and column
directions.axis: Porsche's frame, the dealer's water: the photograph takes 880 of 1440 px and the question lives in one 560 px warm-white column — name, honesty line, then two doors stacked under a labelled rule, the primary said by fill alone.
directions.only: It is the only board where the picture and the question never overlap: a hard vertical edge at x=880, photograph one side, paper the other, so the hero is cropped by a portrait window rather than veiled, and the field carries the fixed half of the answer inside it ("at Northside Marine") the way Slack's workspace door does.

directions.name: Veil and card
directions.axis: The photograph fills the whole window under a layered veil and one glass card carries the entire question — headline, italic underline, field, honesty block and the two doors as full-width rows, each with its own sentence and arrow.
directions.only: It is the only board with no paper at all: every word is set on the photograph, held legible by four stacked veils rather than by a panel, and it is the only one that makes the mark an object — a navy pennant hung off the top edge across a hairline rule, in place of a wordmark in a corner.

directions.name: Two doors mirrored
directions.axis: No hero and no photograph anywhere: the two doors are the composition — two 560 px columns of identical construction either side of one hairline spine at x=720, their buttons on the same baseline at y=782, the primary said by fill alone and never by size.
directions.only: It is the only board that survives a second dealership importing a file with no photography at all — unchanged, not degraded, because there is no picture to be missing; and the only one that puts the file's counts on screen as a real table rather than as a caption.

directions.name: The sheet already open
directions.axis: The entry is not a page before the app but the app with the welcome laid over it: the Master Price File's own table of contents — 53 names and 53 counts from manifest.json — is printed across the whole window as a leadered register, and a dark band is laid over it carrying the name, the two doors and the honesty well.
directions.only: It is the only board where the thing the file door loads is already legible behind the question — every one of the 53 tables named and counted, the register breaking around the band so no row is hidden — and the only one that draws the keyboard order on the page as a sentence.
